_comment: Momentum → Courtside mapping config, consumed by 02_transform.js.
Fail-closed: any entry containing the string 'TODO' (or a null
numeric) that is actually referenced by snapshot data aborts the
transform with a full list of gaps. Fill this in from the live
Courtside admin catalog + a real Setmore export BEFORE the
staging dry run. Offerings/resources/plans are NOT created by the
migration — they are admin-UI prework; these maps only translate
source names onto rows that must already exist.

basic.name: TODO Courtside plan name for Diamond 'basic'
basic.stripe_price_id: TODO price_... from Momentum's connected account

pro.name: TODO Courtside plan name for Diamond 'pro'

unlimited.name: TODO Courtside plan name for Diamond 'unlimited'
unlimited._note: Diamond models unlimited as credits_per_week=999. Courtside has no unlimited concept yet; the 999 value carries over as-is at cutover and is tracked as a known wart in SOURCE_SCHEMA.md.

services.1/2 Hour Hit Trax and Pitching Machine: 1/2 Hour Hit Trax and Pitching Machine
services.Hit Trax (One Hour) + 1 Hour Cage Rental: Hit Trax (One Hour) + 1 Hour Cage Rental

staff_keys._comment: Setmore staff key (or Diamond bookings.staff_key) → Courtside resource name. Unknown until a real Setmore export is inspected; transform fails listing every unmapped key it encounters.

setmore_columns._comment: Header names in the Setmore CSV export → canonical fields. Inspect a real export and replace the TODOs; transform refuses to parse until they are set. Times are naive local wall-clock in the top-level "timezone". OPTIONAL "date": set it when the export splits date and time into separate columns — the parsed start becomes '<date> <start_time>' (and likewise for end); leave it null when start/end carry full timestamps.

setmore_status_map._comment: Setmore status value → Courtside booking status intent ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'no_show'). Past-dated confirmed rows become 'completed' automatically.
